$comment: Where the skill store looks. Marvi never installs from a source it discovered itself - not from a link in a page, not from a model's suggestion. This list is the list, and it is yours to edit. Every repository here was checked to actually serve SKILL.md directories; several well-known 'awesome' lists are READMEs pointing elsewhere and return nothing.

sources.name: Anthropic
sources.description: The official Agent Skills repository. Documents, spreadsheets, slides, and skill-creator.

sources.name: Anthropic Cookbooks
sources.description: A handful of worked examples: financial statements, financial models, brand guidelines.

sources.name: OpenAI
sources.description: Codex's skills. Development-focused - Figma, GitHub, cloud deploys - and useful for working on Marvi herself.

sources.name: Community (wshobson)
sources.description: The largest community collection. Engineering practice: Python, testing, security, observability, incident write-ups.

sources.name: Cloudflare
sources.description: Cloudflare's own: Workers, Durable Objects, email routing.
